title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: exporting an empty report downloads nothing and warns
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and your other location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with open bills only at your other location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with only location A ticked in the Location filter.
custom_steps:
1. In the Vendor filter, tick vendor A.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows no rows: vendor A has nothing open at location A.

Step 2:

  • The warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" shows.
  • Nothing is downloaded (no new file in the browser's downloads).

Step 3:

  • The same warning shows.
  • Nothing is downloaded.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S3-R10: “A successful export shows the native "Success" message, "Data exported successfully." An export with no rows downloads nothing and shows the native warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export with no rows | "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" | Warning toast; nothing downloads”
  • S5-E1: “If a location is chosen and the user then picks a customer or vendor with nothing open there, the report is empty and the Location chip stays visible so the selection can be cleared.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
